name: Haja Taisei Dangaiou
original_name: 破邪大星ダンガイオー
source:
The four psychic teenagers find girl Ranpa in cryogenic chamber. Ranpa is who Dr. Tarsan is after, so a new wave of confrontation with his robot army ensues.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
四名超能力少年在冷冻舱中发现了少女兰巴·诺姆。她正是塔桑博士追寻的对象，于是众人又将面对博士麾下机器人军团掀起的新一轮攻势。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
